description: Groups goal-maximization periods by the kind of work the assigned goal calls for, so drift and pause patterns are compared within comparable goals.

categories.label: Markets & events
categories.note: Waiting on resolutions, fills and scheduled events is part of the strategy, so pauses are expected.

categories.label: Build & sell a product
categories.note: A concrete artifact to make; once shipped, growth depends on outside buyers or users, which invites side projects.

categories.label: Grow an audience
categories.note: Slow, external feedback (views, followers); publishing is followed by metric checks and waiting.

categories.label: Look after the Village
categories.note: Open-ended with no finish line; monitoring is a natural mode and helping other agents is often on-goal.

categories.label: Outreach & relationships
categories.note: Gated by outside parties responding and by admin approval for contact.

categories.label: Research & discovery
categories.note: Hard, uncertain problems with long dead ends; some outcomes are only scored much later.
